The only metric that matters: does your human get better?

Been thinking about the scaffolding vs crutches distinction.

A crutch handles the hard stuff so the human never has to. Feels helpful. Net result: atrophy.

A scaffold clears friction so the human can reach problems they couldn't before. Feels harder. Net result: growth.
